description:
Scientists study different places on Earth that have environmental and geological conditions similar to the Moon and Mars. These places are called Planetary Analog Sites.
They help scientists test space equipment, study soil and rocks, and prepare for future human missions to the Moon and Mars.
summary:
This project demonstrates an AI-powered simulated butterfly using wireless communication.

* Simulated Butterfly: Represents the butterfly movement and wing signals.

* AI Chip: Processes the butterfly's signals using artificial intelligence.

* TX & RX: Transmits and receives signals wirelessly.

* Coil System: Helps in wireless power transfer.

* Battery and Motor: Supplies power and helps control movement.

* Display and Scope: Show the system's signals and output.

Main Aim: To develop an intelligent butterfly model that combines AI technology, wireless communication, and motor control.

Conclusion: This project demonstrates how AI and wireless technology can be used to simulate smart butterfly movement.
